question: Should OpenClaw accept PR #97966 as the canonical fix for #97877's retry/session-state boundary once exact-head validation is refreshed?
rationale: The code shape appears correct, but it changes retry semantics, adds an SDK-exported optional attempt-result field, and overlaps with other candidate PRs.

options.title: Accept #97966 after refresh
